
## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `ProtonIPScanner-<version>-Setup.exe` | **Windows 10/11** — installer with Start menu and desktop shortcuts and an uninstaller |
| `proton-ip-scanner-<version>-windows-portable.exe` | Windows, no installation |
| `proton-ip-scanner_<version>-1_amd64.deb` | **Debian 11+, Ubuntu 20.04+, Linux Mint, Proton OS** |
| `proton-ip-scanner-<version>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Other Linux (plain binary) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums to verify the downloads |

**Proton OS:** install *Proton IP Scanner* from Discover — updates arrive automatically through the Proton OS package repository.

**Windows SmartScreen** may show "Windows protected your PC" because the installer is not code-signed yet. Click **More info → Run anyway**, and compare the file with `SHA256SUMS.txt` (`Get-FileHash` in PowerShell).

Only scan networks you own or have permission to scan.
